name: video-reader
description: Read timestamped video materials and manage a shared task queue and history using a prepared local core.
long_description: Windows adapter for Video Reader 0.10.0rc6: Bilibili, YouTube and local video materials, subtitles, speech, frames, comments, and independent reading tasks/results. Prepare the core and its Python environment first. Reader supplies evidence; the host agent understands it. Scroll Agent is a separate bundle from the same full project release and shares the core. No model, credentials or runtime is bundled.

core_root.title: Video Reader installation
core_root.description: Prepared Windows core folder containing .venv/Scripts/python.exe and config.json.

config_file.description: Select an existing config file, or leave empty to use config.json in the core folder.
